name: com.faolline.graphdialoguesystem
description: Graph-based dialogue library built on com.faolline.graphcore. Spoken lines, speakers, localized text, branching choices, inline conditions/effects, and a headless playback engine.

samples.description: Wiring recipes, plus the UI Toolkit UXML/USS, for showing dialogues in-game with either front-end.

Reuses the standalone DialogueDriver's view/playback behaviour (typewriter, auto-advance, choice timeout, voice, history) for a dialogue embedded in a com.faolline.graphgameflow flow via a SubGraph node. Requires com.faolline.graphgameflow installed.
